paragraphs: R. Chelbo: he became sterile [ואתעקר] from Rav Huna's lectures (Yevamot 64b); see there. R. Abba bar Ilai, in Rav's name. In R. Avdima of Chaifa's name. In R. Elazar ben Torta's name. R. Berekhiah, in his name; see Jerusalem Berakhot, chapter 4, halakhah 4. R. Berekhiah, his son. He transmitted several statements in R. Huna’s name: Berakhot 6b; Moed Katan 26a. Rav Chunah and Rav, in R. Chiyya Rabbah's name: Shekalim, beginning of chapter 1. R. Chelbo [metivah]. In R. Chama bar Ukva's name; in R. Yosi bar Chanina's name: Jerusalem Megillah, chapter 2; see there. “R. Chama bar Gurya said.” In R. Yochanan's name, in R. Yirmeyah's name; R. Chanina in R. Meyasha's name; R. Chiyya in R. Simai's name: Jerusalem Berakhot, chapter 1, mishnah 8. R. Yosi bar Chanina; see above. R. Yosi bar Menashya: Megillah, chapter 2. He asked R. Yitzchak Nappacha: Gittin 60a. In R. Yirmeyah's name; see above. In R. Yishmael bar Nechemyah's name. When he fell ill, Rav Kahana made a proclamation: Nedarim 40a. R. Mattana: Jerusalem Megillah, chapter 2. In R. Simai's name: Jerusalem Berakhot, chapter 1, mishnah 8. And R. Avira said: Ulla Biraah. Rav Anan, in Rav's name; R. Parnakh, in R. Yochanan's name. In Rav's name; see above. He asked R. Shmuel bar Nachmani: Bava Batra 123a.
